text: The Python row is still fingerprinted on uv.lock alone, so a poetry/pdm/hatch/pip project gets no Python tier — the same shape just fixed for the node row. It was not fixed in the same change because Python's tier is genuinely uv-coupled where node's was not: the verifier form is '.py via uv run --frozen', so widening the signal without settling how a non-uv project dispatches its verifiers would emit a tier whose hooks cannot run.
source: node-row fix 2026-09-03: package.json + any of three lockfiles; the python row left pinned
